script: New bags. Unfamiliar smells. This requires my full and immediate attention. I must inspect every single one, nose first, before you're allowed to put anything away, this is standard procedure and has always been standard procedure. You keep saying, get out of the bag. I am not in the bag, I am conducting research. There could be something important in here. There is probably something important in here. My job is to find out, and my job does not stop just because you say my name in that tone. This kind of intense sniffing investigation isn't just cute either, it's your dog's nose doing something genuinely remarkable. The link's below.
